text: In this cohort of hospitalized patients with substance use disorders, inpatient addiction interventions were associated with significantly lower 30-day readmission rates. Educational counseling and pharmacotherapy initiation reduced readmission risk, whereas self-directed discharge was associated with markedly higher odds of readmission. These findings support the integration of structured addiction consultation services to improve post-discharge outcomes and reduce preventable hospitalizations.
source_label: Rates and factors for 30-day readmission in patients with substance use disorders during the COVID-19 pandemic
